content:
Starting November 14, 2026, Viva will operate a Nuevo Laredo to Cancún air connection with an express stop at Tampico International Airport, where passengers stay on the same aircraft, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, confirmed by the Government of Tamaulipas.

Service will run twice a week, on Tuesdays and Saturdays. The published schedule has flights departing Nuevo Laredo at about 9:40 a.m., arriving in Tampico at 11:00 a.m., and reaching Cancún at about 2:30 p.m. The Nuevo Laredo to Tampico leg takes about 1 hour and 20 minutes.

For travelers in the border region, the new link means reaching the Caribbean without changing planes, with the stop in Tampico built into the same flight.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Nuevo Laredo estrenará conexión con Cancún; conoce cómo llegar al Caribe en noviembre," October 26, 2026

title: Nuevo Laredo to Get Cancún Air Link in November, Twice a Week via Tampico
